event.title: RAHP materiality: VTI session refusal and step-up handoff preservation
event.proposition: Evaluate the VTI session transport change that preserves a trust-task-error document and stepUpHandoff in VtcClient::send_task. Establish that a refusal remains non-authorizing across TSP and HTTPS, that the resumed operation is bound to its original principal, purpose, session and expiry, and that replay, wrong-target, lost details, stale step-up and transport substitution cannot convert refusal or parked state into execution authority. The upstream merged PR reports targeted and end-to-end tests; require independently attributable runtime/canonical RAHP evidence before an assurance determination. This proposition concerns the VTI client consuming path, not the generic error-vocabulary obligation in Toolkit #691 or Registry #4's positive network-answer verification.
